SELECT COALESCE(la.code,'8000') AS code,
  COALESCE(la.name,'Omzet NL') AS naam,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_number) AS aantal,
  COALESCE(SUM(ii.quantity*ii.unit_price),0) AS totaal_excl,
  COALESCE(SUM(ii.btw_amount),0) AS totaal_btw,
  COALESCE(SUM(ii.total),0) AS totaal_incl
FROM invoice_items ii
JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_number=ii.invoice_number
LEFT JOIN ledger_entries le ON le.reference=i.invoice_number AND le.journal='verkoop'
LEFT JOIN ledger_accounts la ON le.account_id=la.id
WHERE i.status='verzonden'
  AND YEAR(i.date)={{ $json.jaar }}
  AND ({{ $json.kwartaal_nr }}=0 OR QUARTER(i.date)={{ $json.kwartaal_nr }})
  AND ({{ $json.maand_nr }}=0 OR MONTH(i.date)={{ $json.maand_nr }})
GROUP BY COALESCE(la.code,'8000'), COALESCE(la.name,'Omzet NL')
UNION ALL SELECT '__geen__','__geen__',0,0,0,0

(SELECT COALESCE(la.code,'ONBEKEND') AS code,
  COALESCE(la.name,'Onbekend') AS naam,
  COUNT(*) AS aantal,
  COALESCE(SUM(e.amount),0) AS totaal_excl,
  COALESCE(SUM(e.btw_amount),0) AS totaal_btw,
  COALESCE(SUM(e.total),0) AS totaal_incl
FROM expenses e
LEFT JOIN ledger_accounts la ON e.ledger_account_id=la.id
WHERE YEAR(e.date)={{ $json.jaar }}
  AND ({{ $json.kwartaal_nr }}=0 OR QUARTER(e.date)={{ $json.kwartaal_nr }})
  AND ({{ $json.maand_nr }}=0 OR MONTH(e.date)={{ $json.maand_nr }})
GROUP BY la.id,COALESCE(la.code,'ONBEKEND'),COALESCE(la.name,'Onbekend')
ORDER BY code ASC)
UNION ALL SELECT '__geen__','__geen__',0,0,0,0

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='bedrijfsnaam' THEN value END),'Mijn Bedrijf') AS bedrijfsnaam,COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='kvk' THEN value END),'') AS kvk,COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='iban' THEN value END),'') AS iban,COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='email' THEN value END),'') AS email,COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='accountant_email' THEN value END),'') AS accountant_email,COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN `key`='logo_url' THEN value END),'') AS logo_url FROM settings
